title: EpiQAL: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Epidemiological Question Answering and Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2601.03471v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable epidemiological reasoning requires synthesizing study evidence to infer disease burden, transmission dynamics, and intervention effects at the population level. Existing medical question answering benchmarks primarily emphasize clinical knowledge or patient-level reasoning, yet few systematically evaluate evidence-grounded epidemiological inference. We present EpiQAL, to our knowledge the first diagnostic benchmark for epidemiological question answering over research literature, comprising three subsets built from open-access articles across diverse diseases. The three subsets progressively test factual recall, multi-step inference, and conclusion reconstruction under incomplete information, and are constructed through a quality-controlled pipeline combining taxonomy guidance, multi-model verification, and difficulty screening. translated_title: EpiQAL：面向流行病学问答与推理的大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 可靠的流行病学推理需要综合研究证据，以在人群层面推断疾病负担、传播动态和干预效果。现有的医学问答基准主要侧重于临床知识或患者层面的推理，但很少有基准系统地评估基于证据的流行病学推断。我们提出了EpiQAL，据我们所知，这是首个针对基于研究文献的流行病学问答的诊断性基准，包含三个基于多种疾病开放获取文献构建的子集。这三个子集逐步测试事实回忆、多步推理以及在不完整信息下的结论重建能力，并通过结合分类法指导、多模型验证和难度筛选的质量控制流程构建而成。在涵盖开源与专有系统共十五个模型上的实验表明，当前……
tldr: EpiQAL是首个基于研究文献的流行病学问答诊断基准，通过三个渐进式子集系统评估大语言模型在事实回忆、多步推理和不完整信息下结论重建方面的能力，实验揭示了当前模型在基于证据的流行病学推断上的不足。
en_tdlr: EpiQAL is the first diagnostic benchmark for evidence-grounded epidemiological question answering over research literature, using three progressive subsets to test factual recall, multi-step inference, and conclusion reconstruction under incomplete information, revealing the limitations of current large language models in epidemiological reasoning.
